stages.ideal_conditions: Consistent soaking rain (15-25 mm/day), warm soil temp
stages.break_risk_mitigation: Delay transplanting; apply light protective nursery irrigation; maintain thin water layer in seedling beds.
stages.storm_risk_mitigation: Protect raised nursery beds from surface runoff erosion.

stages.ideal_conditions: Standing water 2-5 cm, continuous monsoon rainfall
stages.break_risk_mitigation: Weed management to reduce moisture competition; apply potassium spray to enhance drought tolerance.
stages.storm_risk_mitigation: Clear field drainage channels to prevent complete submergence exceeding 48 hours.

stages.ideal_conditions: Saturated soil without intense rain during anthesis
stages.break_risk_mitigation: Life-saving irrigation through farm ponds/borewells; avoid nitrogen fertilizer during active break.
stages.storm_risk_mitigation: Drain excess water immediately after cloudburst; check for blast/bacterial blight post-storm.

stages.break_risk_mitigation: Monitor grain maturity; break conditions actually accelerate harvesting.
stages.storm_risk_mitigation: Harvest mature crop immediately; shelter harvested sheaves from unseasonal squalls/hail.

stages.ideal_conditions: Initial onset rain > 50 mm, well-drained black soil
stages.break_risk_mitigation: Delay sowing if onset break expected; if already sown, apply dust mulch with shallow inter-cultivation.
stages.storm_risk_mitigation: Prevent water stagnation around young seedlings; waterlogging > 24h causes wilt.

stages.ideal_conditions: Alternating sunny days and moderate showers
stages.break_risk_mitigation: Spray 2% DAP or 1% Potassium Nitrate during dry spells to arrest square/boll shedding.
stages.storm_risk_mitigation: Heavy winds and hail cause severe boll drop; ensure deep drainage furrows.

stages.ideal_conditions: 75-100 mm accumulated onset rainfall before sowing
stages.break_risk_mitigation: Do not sow on dry seedbed; delay until revival cycle is confirmed.
stages.storm_risk_mitigation: Avoid crusted surface; break soil crust if heavy shower follows sowing.

stages.ideal_conditions: Consistent soil moisture at root zone (0-30 cm)
stages.break_risk_mitigation: Provide sprinkler irrigation from community water harvesting structure; straw mulching.
stages.storm_risk_mitigation: Drain excess water to avoid root rot.

stages.break_risk_mitigation: Sow in ridges and furrows method for moisture conservation.
stages.storm_risk_mitigation: Provide broadbed furrow to drain flash monsoon runoff.

stages.ideal_conditions: Steady moisture, calm winds for pollen dispersion
stages.break_risk_mitigation: Prioritize life-saving irrigation; dry break causes barren cobs.
stages.storm_risk_mitigation: Severe squalls cause lodging; earthing up along plant rows gives mechanical support.

stages.ideal_conditions: Deep taproot development in well-drained soils
stages.break_risk_mitigation: Intercrop with soybean or green gram; deep roots tap subsoil moisture during break spells.
stages.storm_risk_mitigation: Extremely susceptible to phytophthora blight if fields waterlog.
